name: Gamania Digital Entertainment Co., Ltd.
summary: Gamania Digital Entertainment Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, operates as an integrated internet company in Taiwan, rest of Asia, and internationally. It operates through Game, Commerce, Payment, and Others segments. The company offers MMO/mobile games publishing; and e-commerce, internet entertainment content, crowdfunding, and cloud/IDC/security services. It also provides magazine, newspaper, and periodical publishing; crowd funding; and digital media and general advertising; and customer services.
